name: vefaas
description: Deploy and manage serverless functions on Volcengine veFaaS. Provides CLI-driven workflows for application deployment, function management, sandbox management, and OpenAPI invocation.

description.en: Connect your Volcengine account to deploy and manage serverless functions, applications, and cloud sandboxes with veFaaS CLI.
description.zh-cn: 连接火山引擎账号，通过 veFaaS CLI 部署和管理 Serverless 应用、函数和云沙箱。
description.ja: Volcengine アカウントを接続して、veFaaS CLI でサーバーレスアプリケーション・関数・クラウドサンドボックスをデプロイ・管理します。

interface.longDescription: Deploy and manage serverless applications on Volcengine veFaaS. Supports application deployment, function management, sandbox instances, environment variables, template initialization, domain configuration, and OpenAPI invocation through the veFaaS CLI.
defaultPrompt: 帮我把这个项目部署到 veFaaS
查看 veFaaS 函数日志和实例状态
